title.narrative: Salar Int.: Decentralisering och lokalt självstyre
Salar Int.: Decentralization & Local Governance - Salar Int.: Decentralization & Local Governance/Colombia 2021-2025

description.narrative:
Foincide II Strengthening decentralization and local self governance in Colombia is a four year project that builds on a previous six year intervention named Foincide I Inclusion, accountability and equity at the local level (Sida's contribution ID 5519014), supported by Sida in Colombia (20162022).
The overall objective of this new proposal is to strengthen the capacity of local governments to plan, implement, and follow-up participatory, gender sensitive and accountable local politics throughout the public policy cycle. The project targets public officials at local level as well as national entities responsible for promoting decentralization.
To achieve this overall objective, Foincide II is structured around four components, each with two outcomes framed at the national and local levels, as follows:
Component 1: Citizen Dialogue Outcome 1A: The municipalities integrate participatory and gender sensitive processes in the development and implementation of more inclusive, representative, and responsive public management. 1B: The national government promotes their approach to citizen participation by considering the municipal context and autonomy.
Component 2: Social Mediation Outcome 2A: The municipalities consciously identify, analyze, manage, and prevent social conflicts on the local level related to public decisions or public management. 2B: The national government integrates municipal perspective to prevent social conflict through dialogue and mediation.
Component 3: Planning capacities: Outcome 3A: The municipalities increase their ability to use tools and data to design and implement responsive, inclusive, and sustainable plans and policies, benefiting both women and men, girls and boys. 3B: The national government considers the municipalities needs in the design of tools to effectively help municipalities in their planning processes.
Component 4: Gender mainstreaming: Outcome 4A: The municipalities proactively adopt and promote gender sensitive planning and local service delivery to effectively reduce the gap between women and men. Outcome 4B: The national government and other stakeholders recognize the challenges in adopting gender sensitive planning and local service delivery and include a municipal perspective in the promotion of gender mainstreaming.

Projektets övergripande mål är att stärka lokala myndigheters kapacitet att planera, genomföra och följa upp deltagande, genuskänslig och ansvarsfull lokal politik under hela den offentliga policycykeln.

The objective of the project support to Foincide II, implemented by SALAR International, is to strengthen the capacity of local Colombian governments to plan, implement, and follow-up participatory, gender-sensitive and accountable local politics throughout the public policy cycle. This is achieved through four components: 1) Citizen dialogue. 2) Social mediation. 3) Planning capacities. 4) Gender mainstreaming. This project is a continuation of an earlier contribution with ID-number: 55190014.
